body:
Rich styled text containing a literal tab currently sends U+0009 to strict font measurement and fails. Split tabs into source-preserving layout controls using the existing four-space tab convention, preserve UTF-16 run ranges and styles, and exclude the controls from glyph-outline measurement.

This is the core half of the rich-tab repair. The companion renderer change consumes the explicit tab advances; this PR does not establish native PowerPoint tab fidelity or change any tolerance, schema, package version, release pin, or golden.

Validation: Node24.21.0 / pnpm10.33.2 core build and test suite (589 tests plus composition, pagination, data, rich-text, new rich-tab, and list controls), typecheck, text integrity, spec integrity, and diff checks. Local old/new package-pair controls distinguish the core repair from the predecessor's remaining renderer behavior.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes core rich-text layout and composition outline math; behavior is localized but affects any styled content with literal tab characters.
> 
> **Overview**
> **Rich text tabs** are no longer measured as glyph strings. `fitRichText` splits runs on `\t`, emits `RichTextFragment` entries with `kind: 'tab'` and the same **four measured spaces** tab-stop advance used for code/source text, while keeping UTF-16 offsets, run styles, and superscript/subscript sizing.
> 
> **Outline placement** in `composeSlide` skips tab fragments when aggregating vector ink bounds, matching plain-text tab segments.
> 
> A new **`test/rich-tab.mjs`** suite is wired into the package `test` script; it covers edge tabs, emoji/UTF-16, mixed scripts, wrapping in table-like fixtures, `composeSlide` integration, and errors when space width is zero.
>
